# 1. Dispatch Military Instructors
oe_war2_act_dispatch_instructors = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_MILITARY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = no
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 24
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		army_tradition >= 30
		gold >= 80
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			num_locations > 0
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			army_tradition >= 25
			gold >= 50
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_war2_act_dispatch_instructors_cd
		years = 10
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_military }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = { within_diplomatic_range = prev }
		}
		enabled = {
			OR = {
				is_subject_of = scope:actor
				is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor }
				opinion = { target = scope:actor value >= 25 }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -50
				add_favors = { target = scope:recipient value = 10 }
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_act_mission_prestige years = 10 mode = replace }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_act_instructed_army years = 10 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_war2_op_military_instructors }
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_war2_act_dispatch_instructors_tt
		}
	}

	diplo_chance = {
		base = 5
		opinion = 0.4
		diplomatic_reputation = 4
		overlord = 40
		actor_is_rival = -100
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -35
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:recipient = {
					OR = {
						is_subject_of = scope:actor
						is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor }
					}
				}
			}
			add = 55
		}
	}
}

# 2. Demand Border Fort Restraint
oe_war2_act_border_fort_restraint = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_HOSTILE_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		at_war = no
		prestige >= 20
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			prestige >= 15
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_war2_act_border_fort_restraint_cd
		years = 12
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_military }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_neighbor_of = scope:actor
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
		}
		enabled = {
			any_fort_in_country = { has_fort = yes }
			NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_prestige = -10
				add_truce_with = { target = scope:recipient years = 5 mutual = yes }
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_act_fort_restraint_actor years = 10 mode = replace }
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.9 days = 2 }
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_act_fort_restraint_target years = 10 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_war2_op_fort_restraint_accepted }
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_war2_act_border_fort_restraint_tt
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:recipient = {
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_war2_op_fort_restraint_refused }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_war2_buffer_guarantor_against value = scope:recipient years = 10 }
			}
		}
	}

	diplo_chance = {
		base = -25
		relative_strength = 45
		diplomatic_reputation = 5
		opinion = 0.25
		actor_is_rival = -40
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -45
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					is_rival_of = scope:recipient
					army_size >= scope:recipient.army_size
				}
			}
			add = 65
		}
	}
}

# 3. Propose Treaty Port Lease
oe_war2_act_propose_port_lease = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		has_ports = yes
		gold >= 200
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			has_ports = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			gold >= 120
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_war2_act_propose_port_lease_cd
		years = 15
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			has_ports = yes
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = { within_diplomatic_range = prev }
		}
		enabled = {
			num_of_ports >= 1
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -120
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_act_port_lessee years = 15 mode = replace }
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.7 days = 2 }
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_gold = 120
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_act_port_lessor years = 15 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_war2_op_port_lease_accord }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					can_add_relation = {
						first = scope:recipient
						second = scope:actor
						type = relation_type:oe_war2_rel_treaty_port_concession
					}
				}
				create_relation = {
					type = relation_type:oe_war2_rel_treaty_port_concession
					first = scope:recipient
					second = scope:actor
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_war2_act_propose_port_lease_tt
		}
	}

	diplo_chance = {
		base = -15
		opinion = 0.4
		diplomatic_reputation = 5
		relative_strength = 20
		actor_is_rival = -100
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -40
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					has_markets = yes
					gold >= 250
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					num_of_ports >= 2
				}
			}
			add = 60
		}
	}
}

# 4. Sponsor Cultural Exhibition
oe_war2_act_cultural_exhibition = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_FRIENDLY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		at_war = no
		gold >= 150
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			num_locations > 0
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			gold >= 80
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_war2_act_cultural_exhibition_cd
		years = 10
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = { within_diplomatic_range = prev }
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = -80
				add_prestige = 8
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_act_cultural_host years = 10 mode = replace }
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_war2.10 days = 2 }
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_prestige = 5
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_war2_mod_act_cultural_guest years = 10 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_war2_op_cultural_exhibition }
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_war2_act_cultural_exhibition_tt
		}
	}

	diplo_chance = {
		base = 10
		opinion = 0.35
		diplomatic_reputation = 5
		same_religion = 8
		actor_is_rival = -100
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -30
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					gold >= 200
					opinion = { target = scope:recipient value >= 25 }
				}
			}
			add = 50
		}
	}
}
